parent_objective: run smoke PPO proposal from M325 base, exact repair it, then test source-diverse protected acceptance and first replay gates

public_gates: exact M297 and exact M270 no-regression versus M325 after repair
M183/M170 first replay gate versus M325
M267/M264 first replay gate versus M325
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip source-diverse protected gates
do not tune from private holdouts
hypothesis: A smoke PPO proposal from the M325 source-diverse public base can be exact-repaired and accepted by source-diverse protected gates plus first replay gates without returning to old 9944 alpha clipping.
success_criteria: raw PPO completes and writes checkpoint
repaired candidate does not regress exact M297 or exact M270 versus M325
old 9944 diagnostic is reported and classified
M183/M170 and M267/M264 first replay gates pass
failure_criteria: exact repair fails or exact objectives regress

decision_rule: M327 may only admit a full public-gate milestone if exact repair, source-diverse protected gate, old-key diagnostic classification, and M183/M170 plus M267/M264 first replay gates pass.
